subject: TheraCloud GCP private-offer MAP and acceptance timeline
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Avery Singh <avery.singh@theracloud.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP draft + proposed acceptance criteria (GCP private offer)

Hi Avery —

Thanks for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) for Ther aCloud's planned GCP private-offer purchase. The doc focuses on the evaluation cadence, milestone acceptance tests, and the billing path through GCP Marketplace. High level:

- Week 0–2: Pilot setup (RD instance, test prompts, logging enabled)
- Week 3: Acceptance evaluation (quality, latency, cost metrics — see acceptance checklist)
- Week 4: GCP private-offer activation & billing alignment (invoice routing & PO)

Requests for you:
- Confirm procurement stakeholders and preferred invoice contact
- Any org constraints on billing terms (net30/net45), tax IDs, or master agreement redlines

I attached the draft MAP (20261018-theracloud-map-draft.pdf) and a short checklist. We can iterate fast — propose a 30-minute follow-up Wed to lock acceptance criteria.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: 20261018-theracloud-map-draft.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Avery Singh <avery.singh@theracloud.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ther aCloud Procurement <procurement@theracloud.ai>, Sarah Lawson <sarah.lawson@theracloud.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft + proposed acceptance criteria (GCP private offer)

Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP draft. This looks promising. A few immediate notes from procurement and legal:

- Procurement: we need a PO template that shows how the private-offer invoice will be issued (billing contact is AP team: ap@theracloud.ai). We also need the tax ID and Redwood's W-9 for our finance team.
- Legal: we'll want to review MSA redlines up front — Sarah is on copy and will send a consolidated redline.
- Timeline: our internal decision meeting is 10/25; if we can complete technical acceptance and have the private-offer created by 10/22 that would be ideal.

I attached our procurement checklist (TheraCloud-PO-requirements.xlsx) for your reference. Also looping Ben Avery at GCP Partner (ben.avery@gcppartner.com) who will drop in on the private-offer creation steps.

Can you confirm the acceptance test harness we'd use (logs, sample prompts, and pass/fail thresholds)? If so we can lock the Wed call.

Thanks,

Avery Singh
Head of Platform
TheraCloud
avery.singh@theracloud.ai

Attachments: Ther aCloud-PO-requirements.xlsx (XLSX, procurement fields)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Avery Singh <avery.singh@theracloud.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>, Ben Avery <ben.avery@gcppartner.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft + proposed acceptance criteria (GCP private offer)

Avery — appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses below, and next steps at the bottom.

Acceptance harness (summary):
- We will run a 48-hour pilot with a fixed prompt suite (we suggest 150 representative prompts).
- Metrics: median latency < 350ms p50; 99th percentile < 900ms; quality score (customer eval capture) average >= 4/5 across sampled completions.
- Failure conditions: model hallucination rate > 10% on labeled set; sustained latency > 1.5s for >10% of requests.

Procurement / Billing path:
- Private-offer flow: Redwood creates Private Offer in GCP Marketplace once MSA/order form agreed. GCP issues monthly invoices to Ther aCloud AP (ap@theracloud.ai) per PO number.
- Redwood finance will provide W-9 and vendor onboarding packet during the DocuSign signature step.

Legal / MSA:
- We expect some redlines on warranty/LI clauses. We can accept most commercial redlines but will need to escalate any net45 payment terms — default Redwood net30.

Proposed milestone schedule:
1) 10/18–10/20: Iterate MAP & legal redlines
2) 10/21: Final acceptance criteria confirmed; Redwood to generate private-offer draft with price/commit
3) 10/22–10/23: Pilot run and evaluation (48h window)
4) 10/25: Executive decision (TheraCloud) & signature

Next steps:
- I'll share MAP v1.1 with your procurement/legal (attached).
- Ben: can you confirm GCP-side time to spin the private offer once we hand over the order form?

If Wed at 2pm PT still works, let's lock it.

Thanks —

Kim

Attachments: MAP-v1.1.docx (DOCX, updated acceptance criteria)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: discount approval & finance gating for Ther aCloud

Kim / Grace —

Internal note (not for external):
- Finance will entertain a single-year committed discount up to 18% if Ther aCloud signs a 12-month commit and accepts net30. Anything beyond (net45 or payment delays) drops the discount to 12% and requires RevOps sign-off.
- Legal: keep an eye on indemnity caps — push for standard $5M cap where possible.

I'll be on the Wed call to support pricing and to confirm the PO/invoice mapping.

Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
jonas_weber@redwood.inference

(Internal attachment: pricing-model-summary.xlsx)

From: Sarah Lawson <sarah.lawson@theracloud.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Ther aCloud redlines (MSA) + payment term request

Kim / team —

Attached are Ther aCloud's redlines to the MSA (Ther aCloud_MSA_redline.pdf). Key items:
- Requesting Net45 payment terms due to our internal billing cycle
- Asking for one additional 30-day warranty on service credits (we'll outline specific SLO exceptions)

We are prepared to sign quickly if we can resolve the payment term and an IP clause around customer data usage. We also prefer DocuSign for the final signature flow.

I've uploaded the redline and included a DocuSign starter link below for the order form if you want to pre-seed it while we finish the MSA.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/signature-request/abc123

Best,

Sarah Lawson
Sr. Counsel, Ther aCloud
sarah.lawson@theracloud.ai

Attachments: Ther aCloud_MSA_redline.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Avery Singh <avery.singh@theracloud.ai>, Sarah Lawson <sarah.lawson@theracloud.ai>, Ben Avery <ben.avery@gcppartner.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-20T17:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ther aCloud redlines (MSA) + payment term request

Thanks Sarah / Avery — good progress here. Quick summary and asks so we have a single source of truth: 

1) MAP & pilot: we will run the 48-hour pilot on 10/22 using the accepted prompt set (we'll share the harness link by 10/21 EOD).
2) Billing: Redwood can set the private offer in GCP and map invoices to ap@theracloud.ai. Redwood finance will upload W-9 during DocuSign.
3) Payment terms: Redwood's standard is net30. Jonas flagged discount sensitivity if net45 is requested — open to discussing a one-time extended term with a revenue-protection clause.
4) Legal: we'll review the redlines and propose counterpoints on the indemnity and IP paragraphs by EOD 10/21.
5) Signatures: we'll pre-seed the DocuSign order form so when MSA is agreed we can finalize quickly.

Action items:
- Sarah: confirm whether net45 is a hard constraint or negotiable (answer by 10/21)
- Ben: confirm GCP private-offer creation SLA (we need confirmation of creation within 24 business hours after order-form submission)
- Jonas / Grace: I'll loop finance to prepare the W-9 and vendor packet (expected 10/21).

Proposed final meeting: 10/21 2pm PT — 30 minutes to close acceptance criteria and logistics. If that works, I will send the invite and include DocuSign link in the calendar.

Thanks again —

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.inference

Attachments referenced in thread: 20261018-theracloud-map-draft.pdf; Ther aCloud-PO-requirements.xlsx; MAP-v1.1.docx; Ther aCloud_MSA_redline.pdf
